mapper.insert: insert into admin_notification(request_id, receiver_role, is_read, read_at) values(#{requestId}, #{receiverRole}, #{read}, #{readAt})
mapper.select: select count(*) from admin_notification where receiver_role = 'ADMIN' and is_read = 0
mapper.update: update admin_notification set is_read = 1, read_at = current_timestamp where request_id = #{requestId} and receiver_role = 'ADMIN' and is_read = 0
